info.name: Apple iCloud Sync
info.summary: One-way sync of iCloud Photos, Drive, Contacts, Calendars and Reminders into Nextcloud
info.description:
Mirrors your Apple iCloud data into Nextcloud:
- **Contacts** and **Calendars** via Apple's CardDAV/CalDAV (app-specific password) - **Photos**, **iCloud Drive** and **Reminders** via the iCloud web API (Apple ID password + two-factor authentication)
Sync is one-way: nothing is ever written back to iCloud.
info.author: Vincent
